title: 第16章 科技使人解放双手
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
“就为了这事？”

    花期走去厨房，回来时手上拿着一个透明色的折叠杯子。

    她将杯子拉开放在荣华手边，道：

    “这是折叠榨汁机，你下午走的时候把它拿回去，趁着没人看见直接将芒果剥皮丢进杯子，加一点点水就能把果肉榨成果汁或者果泥。”

    “其余的食物也是同样，它什么都能榨，最适合你们躲着偷吃的人。”

    榨汁机一共只有两个按键，一个按键表面画着水滴形状，一个画着肉泥形状。

    拉开之后容量扩大，和古代茶壶差不多。

    折叠后身形缩小，薄薄一层又和手掌差不多。

    唯一的区别是这台榨汁机需要充电，它是太阳能的，充一次电只能用上一个月。

    荣华听完介绍满眼惊叹。

    没想到大人手里还有如此仙器，只需要放在阳光下便能使用。

    任何食物都能搅碎成果汁或者糊糊，既不用担心被别人发现，也不用担心偷吃时香味被闻到。

    荣华悬着的心马上被榨汁机抚平，“多谢大人，我今晚就回去试试。”

    花期点点头继续坐下吃饭，又递过去一把水果刀，“这把刀也是折叠的，用的时候小心点。”

    “还有我这边有些布鞋，你下午走的时候看看码子合不合适，给你家人带回去，不知道码子的可以后天来找我拿。”

    “按理说五天才休沐两天，不过这几天你累坏了，明天可以休息一天，松松也是一样。”

    荣华满眼感动得起身对花期行了一礼，“多谢大人。”

    ......

    吃完饭，两人一鼠迅速来到种植区。

    今日的任务花期昨晚就已经说了。

    芒果昨天都被摘空了，别的果子还没种下，松松今日负责在地上刨土。

    荣华还是老样子，继续割草开荒。

    但在一人一鼠即将下地的时候，花期却把人拦住。

    “等一会儿，计划有变，我们改变任务。”

    荣华和松松疑惑地望着她。

    计划有变？

    难道不需要开荒了？

    没等多久，一人一鼠的疑问便得到回应。
content_en:
"Just for this?"

    Huaqi walked to the kitchen and came back with a transparent folding cup in her hand.

    She pulled the cup away and put it in Ronghua's hand, saying:

    "This is a foldable juicer. When you leave in the afternoon, take it back, peel the mango and throw it into a cup without anyone seeing it. Add a little water to squeeze the pulp into juice or puree."

    "The same goes for the rest of the food. It can extract anything. It's most suitable for those of you who eat in hiding."

    There are only two buttons in the juicer. One button has a water drop shape painted on the surface, and the other has a meat paste shape painted on it.

    When opened, the capacity expands, making it similar to an ancient teapot.

    After folding, the body shape is reduced, and the thin layer is about the same as the palm of the hand.

    The only difference is that this juicer needs to be charged, it is solar powered and can only last a month on a single charge.

    Ronghua was filled with wonder after hearing the introduction.

    I didn't expect that adults still have such a magical weapon in their hands. They only need to be placed in the sun to use it.

    Any food can be minced into juice or paste, so you don’t have to worry about being discovered by others, or the aroma will be smelled when you eat it secretly.

    Ronghua's hanging heart was immediately soothed by the juicer, "Thank you, sir. I'll go back and try it tonight."

    Huaqi nodded and continued to sit down to eat, then handed over a fruit knife, "This knife is also foldable, so be careful when using it."

    "I also have some cloth shoes here. When you leave in the afternoon, you can see if the size fits you and take them back to your family. If you don't know the size, you can come to me the day after tomorrow to get them."

    "It stands to reason that you only have two days off after five days, but you've been exhausted these past few days. You can take a day off tomorrow, and the same goes for Songsong."

    Rong Hua's eyes were so moved that he stood up and bowed to Hua Qi, "Thank you, sir."

    ...

    After eating, the two people and the mouse quickly came to the planting area.

    Today’s mission was mentioned last night.

    All the mangoes were picked yesterday, and other fruits have not been planted yet. Today, Songsong is responsible for digging the soil on the ground.

    Ronghua is still the same as before, continuing to cut grass and open up wasteland.

    But when one person and one mouse were about to go to the ground, the flower season stopped them.

    "Wait a moment, the plan has changed, we will change the mission."

    Ronghua and Songsong looked at her doubtfully.

    Change of plans?

    Don’t we need to open up wasteland?

    It didn't take long for one person and one mouse to answer their questions.
